issues.desc: background.md Solution Tradeoffs section mentions omx as a deferred item ("omx (a deliberate disable guard)") without defining what omx is or what it guards — a newly-onboarded reader has no context for this term. Since it is only in the exclusion/deferred list and does not affect story execution, impact is low.
